newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen mixed on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen mixed on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Monday's settlement day, dealers said.
They said floor sentiment was bearish amid uncertain political situation but the index was likely to move up as speculators would cover their short positions.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 9.46 points, or 0.68 percent, to end at 1,392.03 on Sunday. Turnover was 17.84 million shares, up from 0.7 million in the previous session. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
